Window Cleaning

Outside, we use deionized water, which has had all its minerals removed. Spots and streaks are minerals left behind when normal water dries, so pure water dries clean. Inside, we use a professional squeegee and solution.

Exterior window cleaning starts at $150 and interior at $200. Your exact price depends on how many windows you have, how many stories, and access. We give you a free, exact quote before any work starts.

Most North Shore homeowners do twice a year, in spring and fall. Homes near busy roads, trees or construction often do three visits a year, which is our best-value plan.

Screen Cleaning

Screen cleaning is added to a window cleaning visit, since we are already removing the screens to clean the glass. Ask for it when you request your quote.

We do not rescreen, but we will point out any torn or bent screens we find so you can get them fixed.

Pressure Washing

Not when it is done right. We adjust pressure and technique for every surface, and we soft wash siding at low pressure instead of blasting it.

Sidewalks start at $75, patios at $150, driveways at $200 and a house soft wash at $300. Every quote is free.

We use an eco-friendly solution and rinse thoroughly. We are happy to walk you through what we use before we start.

Gutter Cleaning

At least once a year, and twice if you have trees near the house. Late fall, after the leaves come down, is the most important visit.

It cleans the outside face of the gutter, where the black "tiger stripe" streaks form. It starts at $100 and pairs well with window cleaning.

Commercial Window Cleaning

Yes. Ask about early-morning visits when you request your quote and we will work around your hours.

Commercial work is quoted per building after a free walkthrough, based on glass count, height and how often you want service.
